markers.title: Grid shows no reservation bars
markers.body: Every room row (1–10) is completely empty across all 5 visible days, despite Home reporting 21 check-ins and 78% occupancy for today. Either the booking bars aren't rendering for this date range, or the grid needs an explicit empty state — right now it reads as broken, not empty.

markers.title: "Unallocated (10) ›" link undersized
markers.body: 17dp tall, well under the 44dp tap target minimum. Same undersized-link pattern repeats for every room-type section header (Deluxe Suite, Family Room, etc.) below.

markers.title: "Today" / "+ Add" buttons under 44dp
markers.body: Both header buttons render at 17dp tall — far short of the iOS HIG 44dp minimum. Increase vertical padding rather than the font size.

markers.title: Day-scroll chevron far too small
markers.body: The '›' control is only 9×26dp — well under the 44×44dp minimum on both axes. Widen the tappable hit area well beyond the visual glyph.

working_well: Sticky day-of-week header with the selected date bold + underlined makes the current position in the week unambiguous.
Room-type grouping (Bridge Room, Deluxe Suite, Family Room) with per-section unallocated counts gives a fast overview of inventory gaps.
Room icons are grouped consistently per row, keeping the left rail scannable even with 22 rooms listed.
worth_considering: If the grid is intentionally empty because bookings render as a separate overlay layer, confirm that layer is actually wired up for this environment — as shipped it's indistinguishable from a bug.
Add a subtle vertical divider or shading per day column so date boundaries are legible even without any booking bars present.
